ns2:section.sectionText: Introduces T&M students to the history, culture, and business environment in South Africa. Students will engage in company visits, lectures, and experiential learning opportunities to learn more about a variety of businesses in South Africa from large corporations to NGOs to startups. This trip will occur Dec.30 - Jan.15.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Technology and Management major(s) or minor(s). Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
